messages:
Priya Shah: Quick PR opened to update the audit webhook sample and retention examples — field rename audit_event -> event_name, plus a handful of SDK snippets. Need docs + legal wording review before freeze. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842
Elena Kaur: On it. can you paste the new webhook payload here so I can check it's minimal and SOC2-friendly? :eyes:
Priya Shah: sure — new minimal example I added to the PR:
```json
{
  \"event_name\": \"user.login\",
  \"tenant_id\": \"t-1234\",
  \"timestamp\": \"2026-03-01T12:34:56Z\",
  \"actor\": { \"type\": \"service\", \"id\": \"svc-foo\" },
  \"details\": { \"pseudonymized_user_id\": \"usr-xxxx\", \"ip\": \"redacted\" }
}
```
Notes: removed raw email/phone, replaced with pseudonymized_user_id; ip is redacted in docs example.
Ben Rodriguez: I'll update the Python and Go SDK snippets to parse event_name/pseudonymized_user_id. Example Python change in PR: `event = payload.get(\"event_name\")` — keeping parse simple.
Mike Thompson: One thing — retention wording. Do we say "90 days by default" in docs? SOC2 reviewers liked explicit numbers but legal usually wants configurable + legal-hold note.
Legal - Compliance: Prefer: "Default retention for audit events: 90 days (configurable)." Add a short sentence about legal hold and export options; avoid words like "permanent". Also include link to evidence playbook.
Docs Bot: linkcheck: PR currently references /evidence-playbook which returns 404 on staging.
Priya Shah: thanks — I'll update the link and add a short paragraph about retention policy and legal hold. Also thinking to include an example curl export with a redaction flag — would be helpful for customers. Thoughts?
Elena Kaur: yes please add `--redact-keys` example and show the exported JSON with \"ip\": \"[redacted]\". keeps expectations clear.
Ben Rodriguez: LGTM for code changes. also add a changelog note about the field rename and a deprecation window (e.g., keep audit_event for 60 days with warning header).
Mike Thompson: I'll reword the retention section: "By default audit events are retained for 90 days. Customers can extend retention via contract; legal holds override TTLs." Will push a minor edit. :white_check_mark:
Priya Shah: awesome — I'll push amended commit in ~20m, assign reviewers @Elena @Ben @Legal - Compliance, and fix the broken link. Once edits are in I'll ask for a quick pass for SOC2 phrasing. Thanks all.
Docs Bot: Reminder: once merged, run `npm run linkcheck` and add the PR number to the docs release notes.
